candidate_protocol_audit.candidate_source: train-set popularity/transitions/hyper-coactivation plus observed-prefix social neighbors

methodology: MINDS-style sequential hypergraph proxy + FOREST-style macro/micro consistency + CasFT-style neural-ODE trend decoder
note: KT2 formal local joint model: prefix-feature encoder plus GRU sequence encoder, MINDS-style sequential transition/social/hyper-coactivation context, macro size head, micro next-hop head, CasFT-style Euler neural-ODE trend decoder, and FOREST-style macro/micro consistency loss. It is not an original FOREST, MINDS, CasFT, DyGFormer, or HyperIDP reproduction.

research_migration.MINDS: sequential transition/social/hyper-coactivation context GRU plus macro/micro orthogonality regularizer approximates cross-cascade diffusion state and task disentanglement
research_migration.FOREST: observed activation-sequence GRU and macro/micro count-consistency loss constrain scale and next-hop predictions
research_migration.CasFT: trend branch is an Euler neural-ODE-style decoder supervised by future cumulative popularity checkpoints; it is not the CasFT diffusion model
research_migration.DyGFormer_TGN: micro branch remains a temporal next-hop ranking task over leak-checked candidates

joint_training.shared_encoder: fusion of prefix/candidate MLP, observed-sequence GRU, and cross-cascade context encoder
joint_training.sequence_encoder: GRU over observed t_obs activation sequence
joint_training.cross_context_encoder: GRU over MINDS-style sequential transition/social/hyper-coactivation context
joint_training.trend_auxiliary: Euler neural-ODE-style trend decoder supervised on 4 future cumulative-size checkpoints
joint_training.diffusion_auxiliary: Gaussian noising and denoising loss over normalized future trend checkpoints
joint_training.adversarial_regularizer: gradient-reversal task/stage adversaries over shared propagation state
joint_training.reinforced_coupling: FOREST-style reward-weighted micro policy loss from event-level macro prediction quality
joint_training.methodology: MINDS sequential hypergraph proxy with adversarial disentanglement, FOREST reward-weighted macro/micro policy coupling, CasFT neural-ODE-style trend decoding with denoising diffusion auxiliary
joint_training.trend_target: future cumulative cascade size checkpoints after t_obs
joint_training.consistency_loss: MSE(log1p(macro predicted growth), log1p(sum sigmoid(candidate logits))) plus reward-weighted micro policy BCE from macro prediction quality

note: Unified framework audit row; not a standalone paper-model reproduction.
